'''2012 US Nationals Day 1 Mark Peterson LS Plead My Case To The Senate''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mark Peterson]] at [[2012 US Nationals]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Lukes Bionic Hand
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
